title: Containers (xero)
description: Per-container CPU, memory and network from cAdvisor.

panels.title: Container CPU (max)
panels.description: 100% = one full core; xero has 4. Each point is the max 5s value in its interval. Top 8 containers by peak over the selected range; `docker run` one-offs are one line.

targets.expr: (max_over_time((100 * (sum by (name) (irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!="",name!~"[a-z]+_[a-z]+"}[30s])) or sum by (name) (irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name=~"immich_.+"}[30s])) or label_replace(sum (irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name=~"[a-z]+_[a-z]+",name!~"immich_.+"}[30s])), "name", "one-off (docker run)", "", "")))[$__interval:5s])) and on (name) topk(8, max_over_time((100 * (sum by (name) (irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!="",name!~"[a-z]+_[a-z]+"}[30s])) or sum by (name) (irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name=~"immich_.+"}[30s])) or label_replace(sum (irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name=~"[a-z]+_[a-z]+",name!~"immich_.+"}[30s])), "name", "one-off (docker run)", "", "")))[$__range:1m] @ ${__to:date:seconds}))

panels.title: Container CPU (p95)
panels.description: Top 8 containers by peak over the selected range; `docker run` one-offs are one line.

targets.expr: (quantile_over_time(0.95, (100 * (sum by (name) (irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!="",name!~"[a-z]+_[a-z]+"}[30s])) or sum by (name) (irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name=~"immich_.+"}[30s])) or label_replace(sum (irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name=~"[a-z]+_[a-z]+",name!~"immich_.+"}[30s])), "name", "one-off (docker run)", "", "")))[$__interval:5s])) and on (name) topk(8, max_over_time((100 * (sum by (name) (irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!="",name!~"[a-z]+_[a-z]+"}[30s])) or sum by (name) (irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name=~"immich_.+"}[30s])) or label_replace(sum (irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name=~"[a-z]+_[a-z]+",name!~"immich_.+"}[30s])), "name", "one-off (docker run)", "", "")))[$__range:1m] @ ${__to:date:seconds}))

panels.title: Container memory, working set (max)
panels.description: Top 8 containers by peak over the selected range; `docker run` one-offs are one line.

targets.expr: (max_over_time(((sum by (name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{name!="",name!~"[a-z]+_[a-z]+"}) or sum by (name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{name=~"immich_.+"}) or label_replace(sum (container_memory_working_set_bytes{name=~"[a-z]+_[a-z]+",name!~"immich_.+"}), "name", "one-off (docker run)", "", "")))[$__interval:5s])) and on (name) topk(8, max_over_time(((sum by (name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{name!="",name!~"[a-z]+_[a-z]+"}) or sum by (name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{name=~"immich_.+"}) or label_replace(sum (container_memory_working_set_bytes{name=~"[a-z]+_[a-z]+",name!~"immich_.+"}), "name", "one-off (docker run)", "", "")))[$__range:1m] @ ${__to:date:seconds}))

panels.title: Container network received (max)
panels.description: Host-networked containers (caddy, grafana, homeassistant, node-exporter, prometheus) are left out: cAdvisor reports all of xero's traffic for each of them. Top 8 containers by peak over the selected range; `docker run` one-offs are one line.

targets.expr: (max_over_time(((sum by (name) (irate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{name!="",name!~"[a-z]+_[a-z]+|caddy|grafana|homeassistant|node-exporter|prometheus"}[30s])) or sum by (name) (irate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{name=~"immich_.+"}[30s])) or label_replace(sum (irate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{name=~"[a-z]+_[a-z]+",name!~"immich_.+"}[30s])), "name", "one-off (docker run)", "", "")))[$__interval:5s])) and on (name) topk(8, max_over_time(((sum by (name) (irate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{name!="",name!~"[a-z]+_[a-z]+|caddy|grafana|homeassistant|node-exporter|prometheus"}[30s])) or sum by (name) (irate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{name=~"immich_.+"}[30s])) or label_replace(sum (irate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{name=~"[a-z]+_[a-z]+",name!~"immich_.+"}[30s])), "name", "one-off (docker run)", "", "")))[$__range:1m] @ ${__to:date:seconds}))
